title: wsl-notice notification
description: Input to send (stdin JSON or --file). Syntactic gate only: the sanitizer, the post-sanitizing empty-message check (message has no minLength here; an absent message is empty_message too) and the link reasons are applied by the tool.

title.description: One line (the sanitizer turns newlines into spaces); at most 100000 characters of input (else exit 20 invalid_payload); cut to max_title characters at render time.

message.description: At most 100000 characters of input (else exit 20 invalid_payload); must not be empty after sanitizing (exit 20 empty_message).

link.description: Coarse gate for the link rule: 1 to 1024 printable ASCII characters. The tool is authoritative (scheme, host, port, percent escapes, userinfo, link_scheme versus link_invalid, link_hosts).
